Other day I saw that a man is saying me Surah Baqar, Surah Baqar Answer ID: 1503 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1279/985=H) There is some laziness in following Islamic rulings. If you pay a bit attention, follow Shariah and forsake sins then you in-sha-Allah will soon feel improvements in you internal and external conditions.
